svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: I2C timing of a read
svg.desc: I2C timing of a BNO08x read: H_INTN low asks for attention, the host sends a start, the address with the read bit and gets the acknowledge, H_INTN rises after the address, and the read ends with a NAK and a stop.
svg.text: Datasheet: 6.5.1 I2C Timing, p. 46; 6.5.4 Interrupt timing, p. 48; 1.2.2.1 I2C
Hold time for a start condition
Setup time for a stop condition
I2C address recognised to H_INTN deasserted
